wholePhysicalScope: The registered federal NAIP roof and entrance approach establish scale and heading. Cleared front and rear views establish the two projecting bay forms, porch and attached ranges; wall lines are inferred under roof edges and tree cover.
lodDetails: Four levels preserve the paired Italianate bays, central columned porch and attached ranges. Closer levels refine arched sash, capitals, balusters and eave brackets.
limitations: The June 2009 exterior omits interiors, detached buildings and private landscape features. The extent of obscured wall lines, rear windows and roof folds is approximate. Columns, brackets and sash ornament are simplified.
Federal orthophotography controls scale and position. The original terrain remains unchanged. Step and threshold contact is approximate.
